messages:
joan: Found another docs drift - Ruby quickstart still uses hardcoded token and suggests naive retry loop. SUP-4501.

mike: where in the repo?

joan: docs/quickstart/ruby.md. snippet shows:

``joan: require 'net/http'
uri = URI('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate')
req = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri)
req['Authorization'] = 'Bearer sk-EXAMPLETOKEN'  # <- literal token
req.body = { prompt: 'hello' }.to_json
res = Net::HTTP.start(uri.hostname, uri.port, use_ssl: true) { |http| http.request(req) }
puts res.body
```

joan: Also the example recommends the naive retry: 3.times { ... sleep 1 }, which is not great (no jitter/expo backoff) and doesn't handle idempotency.

tara: thanks for flagging. Quick wins: replace literal with ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY'], add a safe Net::HTTP pattern (timeout, raise on non-2xx), and swap naive retry with a tiny exponential backoff helper.

mike: can we also add a note saying our Ruby SDK auto-retries 429/5xx with jittered exponential backoff and connection pooling? People copy raw HTTP and think SDK behaves the same.

joan: yes. I'll update the snippet to show both: a one-off safe curl/ruby pattern and the SDK usage. Example idea:

``joan: # safe raw HTTP (one-liner pattern)
API_KEY = ENV.fetch('REDWOOD_API_KEY')
uri = URI('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate')
req = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri)
req['Authorization'] = "Bearer "+API_KEY
res = Net::HTTP.start(uri.hostname, uri.port, open_timeout: 5, read_timeout: 10, use_ssl: true) do |http|
  http.request(req)
end
res.value  # raise on 4xx/5xx
```

``joan: # SDK usage (preferred for production)
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.generate(prompt: 'hello')
```

ops-bot: FYI if a leaked token is found we should rotate keys. Tagging @security.

tara: I'll open a PR to replace the hardcoded token, add the timeout/jittered backoff example, and include a short section: "Why use the SDK?" that mentions retries, pooling, and how to opt out (retries: 0).

mike: also add a docs CI lint: fail if regex like /sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{6,}/ or /REPLACE_ME_WITH/ shows up in markdown. Quick grep in the docs pipeline should be enough.

docs-bot: New PR opened by tara: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/689  — title: "quickstart/ruby: remove hardcoded token, add safe raw-http + SDK diff, add docs-lint"

joan: thanks — please include the exact config for the md-lint check so we can copy it into other repos. Also add a one-line changelog entry for the release notes so support can triage SUP-4501 after merge.

tara: will do. planning to land this afternoon. :rocket:
